speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Like all Integrated Shield Plans (IPs), Standard IP is an optional private insurance.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Currently, IP insurers are allowed to offer riders for coverage of pre-existing conditions.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The premiums for these riders are set by the insurers based on commercial and actuarial considerations.

speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
text: Thirdly, would the Minister of State give his view on whether the Ministry has a role in preventing market failure within the private healthcare insurance industry?

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: For his first question on whether different pre-existing medical conditions will have different risk implications, the answer is yes.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: The second question is whether we would look at allowing insurance companies to provide coverage for pre-existing conditions and charge different premiums.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: The premiums will be calculated based on commercial and actuarial considerations, according to the different risks which different pre-existing conditions carry.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: As for the third question, I think the Member is asking about whether we would look at measures if there is market failure.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: Certainly, we would study this carefully with the industry and to make sure that the insurance scheme is working well for Singaporeans.
